title: SQL Injection in login endpoint
description: The /rest/login endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection via the email parameter.
impact: An attacker can bypass authentication or extract database contents.
technical_analysis: The email field is concatenated into a SQL query without parameterization.
poc_description: Send POST to /rest/login with email=admin' OR '1'='1 and any password to bypass authentication.
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries or an ORM. Validate and sanitize all user inputs.
evidence: HTTP 200 with admin token returned for invalid credentials.
assumptions: Backend uses SQLite or MySQL with string concatenation.

title: Server-Side Request Forgery in profile image upload
description: The profile image URL parameter allows arbitrary internal HTTP requests.
impact: Attacker can access internal services and metadata endpoints.
technical_analysis: URL parameter is fetched server-side without allowlist validation.
poc_description: Set image URL to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ to reach cloud metadata.
remediation_steps: Allowlist permitted domains. Block private IP ranges and link-local addresses.
evidence: Response body contains cloud instance metadata JSON.
assumptions: Application runs in a cloud environment with metadata service available.

title: Information disclosure via debug endpoint
description: The /debug/config endpoint exposes internal configuration including database credentials.
impact: Sensitive configuration data leaked to unauthenticated users.
technical_analysis: Debug endpoint left enabled in production build.
poc_description: GET /debug/config returns JSON with DB connection strings and API keys.
remediation_steps: Disable debug endpoints in production. Use environment-specific configs.
evidence: JSON response includes db_password and api_key fields.
